sql: SELECT "Перевозчик", count(*), quantile_cont(greatest(0,date_diff('second',try_cast("Обещанный срок (МСК)" as timestamp),try_cast("Доставлено (МСК)" as timestamp)))/3600.0,.95) FROM read_csv(?,delim=';',all_varchar=true) WHERE try_cast("Доставлено (МСК)" as timestamp)>='2025-03-01' AND try_cast("Доставлено (МСК)" as timestamp)<'2025-04-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC
